title: perfect boat trip
text:
The boat is beautiful and the crew very friendly. We stopped near to the beach to have a swim.
100% recommendable.
author: yoli74321

title: Beautiful sailing trip
text: I booked the activity with my wife because we love sailing and it was awesome. The skipper let me to steer the weel (I use to sail) and I really appreciate it.
author: Sightseer57817833436

title: Amazing views of Barcelona
text: The views of Barcelona from the sea are amazing. The captain is very friendly and he explains a lot of things about Barcelona. I recommend to do this activity with Barcelona boat trips.
author: albertrobinson3668

title: Amazing
text: We booked the 2 hours sailing trip with friends and it was memorable. The sailboat is beautiful and the service provided by the skipper is very good.
